messages.author: 6824c1e1fe15ab15
messages.subject: Shaded Solar
parts:
I have a question regarding the SOLR output. I recognize that for both the shade and unshaded (metout and shadmet) output in the micro_global function the SOLR output is calculated for an unshaded horizontal plane. Is there a way of calculating solar radiation under shaded conditions (the specified shade values) as well?

Thank you!
Adam

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: Shaded Solar
parts:
Hi Adam,

Easy, just multiply the SOLR column by (1 - SHADE/100), where SHADE is in percent.

All the best,
Mike
